assets.reference_role: Original authoritative artwork; source remains untouched
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: immersive painted browser world, a FULL SPHERE 360-degree equirectangular environment texture, exact 2:1 wide aspect ratio, preferably 4096 x 2048.
Input image 1 is the original artwork and the authoritative style and scene reference. Extend the world of this exact painting into an inferred surrounding environment as though standing inside it. This is one panorama, not panels or a framed painting.
Projection/composition: true longitude-latitude full sphere equirectangular 360 x 180 degrees. Forward direction at horizontal image center, eye-level horizon at exactly vertical image center. Left and right outer edges depict the same rearward direction and join seamlessly with continuous colors/forms; neither edge repeats the main forward composition. Top covers the entire sky/zenith and bottom covers ground/nadir. Natural spherical distortion near top/bottom is expected. Fully painted usable terrain surrounds the camera, including to the rear; no circular platform, floor disk, stage or empty generic floor. Keep ground painted all the way to the bottom edge. Broad forward subject and spatial relationships should clearly recall the source while continuing naturally into the side/rear views.
Absolute style invariants: preserve THIS source painting's actual medium, exact characteristic palette, brushstroke scale relative to features, visible paper/canvas grain, imperfect overlapping brush edges, pigment scumbling and irregular marks. Distant details are organic hand-painted masses. Do not convert into photorealism, realistic 3D, low-poly, polygonal facets, vectors, digital airbrush or generic smooth concept art. No repeated equal trees, duplicated main buildings, mirrors, collage seams, borders, frames, watermarks or readable new business names.

Scene: A near shore of the emerald-turquoise alpine lake faces the distinctive tall rose/coral summit and violet-blue cliffs in the center forward view. Match the original's chunky matte opaque gouache-like paint, loose wide loaded strokes, textured paper, turquoise pale sky, coral pink illuminated rock planes and deep plum-violet shadows. Preserve the summit silhouette and its few irregular pale snow patches. Golden ochre larches mixed with dark blue/green conifers flank the lake; their sizes and shapes vary naturally. Camera stands on a broad irregular earthy/olive painted lakeshore path which continues around the camera and behind, with small rough rocks, mossy brushmarks, patches of dark soil and the same colorful sparse alpine trees. Continue the distant mountain ridges organically to the sides and rear without copying the central summit. Sky remains fully painted to top, uneven source-matched lake/shore/ground to bottom.
assets.continuation: Side, rear, zenith and nadir continuation inferred from source painting
assets.visual_qa_note: Central coral summit and emerald lake; surrounding shoreline and mountains inferred.
